steps.statement: Exact conditional carrier and bundle, with full original denominator.
steps.proof: Let C be complete algebraically closed nontrivially valued rank-one, R=C-circle, a in R with 0<|a|<1, and let F be an ACTUAL proper admissible topologically finitely presented R-formal scheme whose analytic generic fibre is the analytification of the ORIGINAL smooth projective C-curve X. Let L be the ORIGINAL ample line bundle, M0=dL its actual original globally generated power, and let an ACTUAL invertible formal bundle M have generic fibre M0^N=(dN)L under a specified original-bundle identification. Assume every reduced special-fibre component has strictly positive degree for M. These actual-pair and degree antecedents are not supplied by an abstract graph. Working260/266 construct a candidate pair; they are unreviewed. No favorable assertion in whole250/FAIL198 is a grant. The desired exact recognition uses denominator kNd, including every original horizontal and vertical contribution.

steps.statement: Every reduction is finitely presented flat and proper over its actual rank-one quotient.
steps.proof: Write R_j=R/a^jR and X_j=F mod a^j. Admissible topologically fp charts are a-adic completions of restricted polynomial quotients by finitely generated ideals. Reducing mod a^j makes them ordinary fp R_j-algebras. Admissibility gives R-flat charts; base change gives R_j-flat X_j and flat invertible M_j. Rank one implies radical(a^j)=m_R, so Spec R_j has ONE point; m_R/a^j is a NIL ideal with no required common nilpotence exponent. The special fibre is a proper curve. Whole Stacks37.3.4 property8 transfers properness through the actual NIL thickening because the maps are locally finite type, hence X_j is proper. On j=1, positive degrees on ALL reduced components give M_s ample by whole33.44.15; the GENERAL proper-morphism fibre criterion37.50.3, valid without a Noetherian base, gives M_1 relatively ample on the entire one-point base, therefore ample since that base is affine. This is the immediate source application reconstructed in264, not an application of the Noetherian30.21.4 directly to R_1.

steps.statement: Descend the actual mod-a scheme and bundle to one Noetherian approximation stage.
steps.proof: Express R_1 as its directed union of finitely generated Z-subalgebras A_i, each Noetherian. Whole Stacks32.10.1 descends the fp scheme X_1 and finite gluing maps to some fp X_i/A_i; its proof is finite affine presentations, overlap maps, eventual equations and cocycles. Whole32.10.3 descends the invertible bundle and its inverse with the two evaluation isomorphisms; eventual equality of the inverse relations is a finite condition. Whole32.13.1 descends properness, and32.8.7 descends flatness for a locally fp object, at later stages. Whole32.4.15 descends ampleness of this ACTUAL line bundle. Its finite-section proof aligns finitely many section powers using a common multiple; the corresponding affine nonvanishing cover and cover equality descend. Choose one later stage at which all four properties hold. Thus X_i is proper flat finite presentation over Noetherian A_i and L_i invertible ample, with exact base changes X_1,M_1. No Noetherian assertion about R_1 was made. All later transition morphisms of the base-changed X_i are affine, as required by these limit statements.

steps.statement: One sufficiently high power has high cohomology vanishing and finite global generators.
steps.proof: For this ONE Noetherian proper X_i, Serre vanishing in whole Stacks30.16.1 gives H^q(X_i,L_i^k)=0 for every q>0 and all k sufficiently large. Only finitely many q can be nonzero: a finite affine cover of a separated scheme has a finite Cech complex. The same ordinary ample coherent-generation property gives global generation of L_i^k for all sufficiently large k, and proper coherent cohomology gives finite generation of H^0 over A_i. For clarity, generation can be proved from a finite cover by affine nonvanishing loci of positive powers of L_i: local finite generators of a coherent sheaf are cleared of the section denominators and glue after a sufficiently high power; finite cover and finite generators give a common threshold. Here the coherent sheaf is O, and the standard ample-power generation includes all sufficiently large k. This latter elementary generation foundation and every recursively cited proof inside30.16.1 are NOT all freshly ROOT-read; they remain explicit ordinary-background dependencies for whole independent review.

steps.statement: Flat Cech descent gives the actual mod-a vanishing without an unjustified base-change theorem.
steps.proof: Fix one such k and a finite affine cover of X_i. X_i is separated, so all finite intersections are affine; their rings are flat over A_i because X_i is flat, and the modules of L_i^k sections are flat as invertible modules on those rings. The finite Cech cochain complex C^0 through C^r therefore has flat terms and H^q=0 for q>0. Descend from the top: Z^r=C^r is flat; each exact sequence0 -> Z^(q-1) -> C^(q-1) -> Z^q ->0 has flat quotient and flat middle, so its kernel is flat and the sequence stays exact after ANY A_i-module tensor product. Induction gives Z^0=H^0 flat and tensor preserves exactness throughout, including at degree0. Affine cover/intersection sections of the base-changed invertible bundle are precisely these tensor products. Hence H^q(X_1,M_1^k)=0 for all q>0 and H^0(X_1,M_1^k)=H^0(X_i,L_i^k) tensor A_i R_1. Pullbacks of finitely many global generators generate M_1^k by the right-exact evaluation map. No flatness of A_i -> R_1 is assumed.

steps.statement: Lift those generators compatibly through ALL powers of a.
steps.proof: R-flatness and local invertible frames give exact sheaf sequences0 -> M_1^k -> M_(j+1)^k -> M_j^k ->0, where the first map is multiplication by a^j and identifies the kernel a^jM/a^(j+1)M with M/aM. The actual formal scheme charts are a-torsion-free; this exact identification requires that flatness and is not a general nilpotent thickening assertion. Since H^1(X_1,M_1^k)=0, the long exact cohomology sequence gives surjective transition maps on H^0 for EVERY j. Lift the finite generating list successively along these maps. An invertible formal bundle is the inverse limit of its reductions on every formal affine trivialization; its global-section equalizer commutes with inverse limits. The compatible lifted lists are consequently ACTUAL formal global sections s_1,...,s_m of M^k.

steps.statement: The integral sections give max=1 at EVERY actual analytic point.
steps.proof: On an actual affine formal chart with integral frame e, write s_l=f_l e, f_l in its integral ring A. Generation mod a says1= sum_l b_l f_l + a h for some integral b_l,h. The element1-a h is a-adically invertible via the convergent geometric series, since A is complete and a is topologically nilpotent. Multiplying all b_l by its inverse gives the ACTUAL identity1=sum_l c_l f_l with every c_l integral. Equivalently this is the elementary lifting of a unit ideal through an ideal of definition; there is no unknown ideal-completion assumption. At any analytic point of that generic-fibre chart all integral elements have norm at most1. The identity gives1<=max_l |f_l(x)|, while each |f_l(x)|<=1. Thus max_l |f_l(x)|=1 for ALL points, with no restriction to Shilov points, typeII points, or a measure-support locus. In the formal metric ||e||=1, so max_l||s_l(x)||=1 everywhere. This already shows absence of analytic common zeros.

steps.statement: Use the proved rank-one adhesive GAGA scope on the ORIGINAL proper variety.
steps.proof: Whole Fujiwara--Kato v5,0.9.2.7 and I2.1.4(2), put the complete valuation ring R in the t.u.-adhesive scope, using its rank-one principal ideal of definition. Working259 supplies the previously missing immediate original Raynaud--Gruson3.4.6 application in the actual one-point quotient, explicitly correcting M/aM flat over R/a rather than flat over A/a. All recursive GFGA foundations are not freshly ROOT-read. Set S=Spec R and U=S minus V(a)=Spec C, exactly as II9.1(a). The ORIGINAL projective X is proper fp over that U, and the ORIGINAL invertible algebraic (dNk)L is coherent. Apply WHOLE printed derived comparison II9.4.1 to X -> U and this bundle; its q=0 global comparison identifies algebraic H^0(X,(dNk)L) with rigid H^0 of its analytification. The whole9.4 proof reduces to9.4.2 and to the actual affinoid6.4.1 proof; those immediate proof units were ROOT-read, but their recursive I.C.3.3/Deligne/ordinary GFGA foundations were not all freshly reconstructed. Do not invoke the wider merely-rigid-Noetherian assertion announced for[38] as if proved in the printed text, and do not invoke I10.3.2 algebraization whose EGA adaptation is omitted. This is H^0 comparison on an already algebraic ORIGINAL proper X, not algebraization of the unknown formal pair.

steps.statement: Identify every lifted analytic section with a section of the SAME original algebraic bundle.
steps.proof: The analytic generic-fibre carrier/bundle inF1 is already identified with original X and original(dN)L. Working256 reconstructs the immediate whole Berkovich1993 §1.6 and Prop1.3.4 q=0 comparison on the actual good Hausdorff strict proper/projective analytic space, with the same affine-frame cocycles. Hence formal generic sections s_l are rigid analytic sections of the ORIGINAL bundle under that comparison, andF8 identifies them with ORIGINAL algebraic global sections S_l in H^0(X,(dNk)L). All transition/cocycle identifications are retained; no substitute algebraic variety, line bundle or abstract graph map is used. They have no algebraic common zero: over algebraically closed C any nonempty closed common-zero subscheme of the proper original X has a closed C-point, whose analytic point would contradictF7. This elementary closed-point fact is standard field algebraic geometry, not a conclusion from generic incidence at finitely many points.

steps.statement: Exact unweighted original Fubini--Study identity, with the whole tensor power.
steps.proof: On every local original L-frame, the formal metric normalized from M has a weight phi such that the weight onM^k=(dNk)L is(dNk)phi. EquationF7 says max_l(log|S_l(x)|-(dNk)phi(x))=0. Therefore phi(x)=(1/(dNk))max_l log|S_l(x)| at EVERY actual analytic point. This is an honest pure Fubini--Study metric on the SAME original L, generated by actual original algebraic sections with no common zeros. The denominator includes horizontal degree d, vertical-bundle multiplier N and global-section power k. It is not replaced by d, k, a probability mass, or a chart-local scaling. Positive special-fibre degrees give the required semipositive curve reference through the actual construction; no prescribed inverse target has been obtained merely from recognition.
